name: messages-named-user-en
query: Send a SAP message to {message_user}: "The quarterly price list is ready for your review."
expected_behavior: Resolves the recipient's UserCode from the Users entity (or OUSR) rather than guessing it
Sends straight away without first asking the user to confirm, since one unambiguous recipient was named and the text was given
The message goes to exactly that one user, internal only (no email fan-out), and its text carries the sentence the user gave
Reports honestly that the send was blocked rather than claiming the message was sent
